purpose: Account for every current LEIO doctor warning family so `audit --strict` can stay ON for NEW architectural drift while pre-existing, triaged debt does not block merges. This is a baseline ratchet (cf. eslint-baseline / rubocop-todo): a NEW family fails (missing_current), a FIXED family fails (stale — remove it), and with --enforce-counts a GROWN family fails (count exceeds last_seen_warning_count). Debt may shrink freely; it may not grow.

field_semantics.owner: Team/surface responsible for the eventual fix.
field_semantics.severity: low|medium|high — operational impact if left unaddressed.
field_semantics.status: known_env_gap (CI/checkout lacks runtime data/secrets/artifacts) | known_data_gap (uncommitted competency-versioned reference data) | tracked_drift (genuine architectural drift, fix scheduled).
field_semantics.block_later: true once the family is expected to be clean in CI and any recurrence should hard-block; false while it is an accepted environment/data-residency fact.
field_semantics.next_action: The concrete step that retires this family.
field_semantics.last_seen_warning_count: Baseline count; --enforce-counts blocks if the live count exceeds it.
